TEXT_EXCEEDS_400_CHARACTERS: Two letters, evidently from a collection of letters. On recto and first 17 lines of v.a, part of a letter to an unspecificed "princeps" defending a work the letter writer has written; this letter mentions an Archbishop W., possibly Wilchar of Sens (fl. ca. 765-778) or Wolfhar of Rheims (d. 816). Following this letter, beginning of another letter to a "princeps" containing advice in spiritual and practical affairs from an ecclesiastical writer. See Lorenz Weinrich's unpublished article, on file in UC SCRC, for debate on identities of letter writer, possibly Alcuin of York, Paulinus of Aquilaea, Hrabanus Maurus, or Dungal.
